summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow end-to-end for Phase 68 (web integration: rotation UX and durable client state) in the cipher-box repo — research the domain, produce validation strategy and pattern mapping, then spawn the planner to generate PLAN.md files.
summary.outcome: Completed research (RESEARCH.md), VALIDATION.md, and PATTERNS.md with all pre-planning gates (drift check, API surface regen, schema-gate, TDD injection) resolved, and spawned the gsd-planner subagent; the session ends while the planner is still running, before plan-checker verification.

repo: Rotation logic must be wired into packages/sdk/src/client.ts mutation methods (renameItem, moveItem, deleteItem, deleteToBin), not the thin web React hooks which just call client.X() without invoking hasCoveringGrant/rotateReadFromNode.

executeLazyRotation has zero callers in the live tree (deletion path is nearly free to change); addShareKeys/reWrapForRecipients DO have callers in useAuth.ts and useSharedNavigation.ts that need rerouting.

share.service.ts's fetchReceivedShares/fetchSentShares are stub functions that unconditionally throw — D-07's rootGeneration seeding has no real data path yet, even though the generated API client already exposes the needed fields.

reMintGrantsRootedAt's updateGrantFn (D-10/D-11 owner reconcile) has no backing API endpoint — shares.controller.ts lacks a PATCH route for readDescriptorRef/rootGeneration, requiring a new apps/api route plus `pnpm api:generate`, expanding the phase beyond apps/web.
No `idb` npm package anywhere in the repo — durable IndexedDB stores must follow the hand-rolled raw indexedDB Promise-wrapping pattern used in identity.ts and search-index.service.ts.
apps/web/vitest.config.ts only includes src/**/*.test.ts with environment: 'node' — there is no IndexedDB test-env shim (no fake-indexeddb), a Wave 0 gap for testing the new durable store.
New apps/api PATCH routes should mirror updateShareItemName/UpdateItemNameDto exactly: ownership check via sharerId, class-validator decorators, HttpCode(204).
navigator.locks (used for D-09) is a first-time use in this codebase with no existing analog to pattern-match against.

Git commit status reporting in this tool chain can false-negative ('commit_failed') even when the commit actually lands — happened for both VALIDATION.md (8a5d93769) and PATTERNS.md (188321073); always verify via git log/status before trusting the reported failure.

workflow: GSD plan-phase pipeline order: init/validate phase → load context/UI-spec → decide research (AskUserQuestion) → spawn gsd-phase-researcher → VALIDATION.md (from RESEARCH.md's Validation Architecture section, since Nyquist is enabled) → drift check (non-blocking) → regen API surface → spawn pattern-mapper → schema-gate check (skip silently if no schema change needed) → spawn gsd-planner → (pending) gsd-plan-checker loop.

Subagent spawns are announced with a canonical 'runs in a subagent' phrase per ui-brand.md so silence during 1-5 min runs isn't mistaken for a freeze; the orchestrator waits for automatic task-notification rather than polling.

Pattern-mapper and researcher subagents surface scope gaps (missing API endpoints, missing test-env shims) that weren't in the original CONTEXT.md and get explicitly flagged forward to the planner as prerequisite tasks.

friction: Commit-status tool reported 'commit_failed' for both VALIDATION.md and PATTERNS.md even though both commits actually succeeded, requiring an extra verification step (git log/status) each time to confirm.
Research uncovered two scope gaps not captured in CONTEXT.md (missing share-fetch data path, missing API PATCH endpoint) that expand the phase's blast radius from apps/web into apps/api mid-workflow.
